notes: No connector: the card was driven by Yubico's library with the script from the first linked issue; the tool's part is --prepare and --complete.
The key acted as an identity's delegate: publish --as --prepare, signed on the card, --complete. A third store counted the editions and verify exited 0.
Touch policy on: one touch signs one message; an untouched request is refused after 14.56 s (status word 0x6600). Touch policy cached: one touch covered 25 messages over about 15 s.
PIN policy once (factory): one PIN entry unlocks every later signature until the card is unplugged. PIN policy always: a second signature without a new PIN is refused (0x6982).

Size: 3,055 bytes signed in one extended command; with chained short commands 3,072 signed and 3,073 refused by the card (0x6700). A 22-member edition (3,000 bytes) signs; a 23-member one (3,103 bytes) cannot.
